questions.question: What is the main purpose of a constructor in C#?
What must be the same as the class name?
What does a constructor have as its return type?
When is an instance constructor normally called?
Which keyword is commonly used to create an object and invoke its constructor?
Which is a valid parameterless constructor?
What is a parameterized constructor?

options.B: A constructor with one or more parameters

questions.question: If no instance constructor is explicitly defined in a class, what does the compiler generally provide?
What happens if you define a parameterized constructor but no parameterless constructor?

options.A: C# automatically creates a parameterless constructor
options.C: The compiler does not automatically add a parameterless constructor

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes an implicit constructor?

options.A: It is always written by the programmer
options.B: It is supplied by the compiler when applicable

questions.question: What is an explicit constructor?

options.A: A constructor written by the programmer
options.B: A constructor created by the CLR only

questions.question: What is constructor overloading?

options.B: Having multiple constructors with different parameter lists

questions.question: Which is required for constructor overloading?
Can constructors be overloaded?
Which pair demonstrates valid constructor overloading?
Can constructors have access modifiers such as public and private?
What is a static constructor mainly used for?
Which keyword identifies a static constructor?
Which is a valid static constructor?
Can a static constructor have parameters?
Can a static constructor have an access modifier such as public?
How many times does a static constructor run for a given type?

options.A: Every time an object is created

questions.question: What kind of members can a static constructor directly access?
Can a static constructor be overloaded?
What is an object initializer used for?

options.B: Initializing fields/properties when creating an object

questions.question: Which is a valid object initializer?
questions.code: Student s = new Student { Name = "Rahim", Age = 20 };

questions.question: What does this code do?
questions.code: Student s = new Student { Name = "Rahim", Age = 20 };

options.B: Creates an object and initializes its members

questions.question: In an object initializer, which members can normally be assigned?

options.A: Accessible fields/properties that can be assigned

questions.question: What happens first in this code?

options.A: Name is assigned first, then constructor runs
options.B: Constructor runs first, then Name is assigned

questions.question: Which statement is TRUE about an object initializer?

options.B: It prevents the constructor from running
options.C: The constructor runs first, followed by member initialization
options.D: It can only be used with static constructors
